life_summary: George Teasdale was born in 1831 in England and embraced the gospel of Jesus Christ in his youth. He immigrated to America and made his home in Utah Territory, where he became deeply involved in the work of the Church. Like many British converts, Teasdale brought with him a strong educational background and commitment to community building. He lived during the era of intensive missionary work and was recognized for his ability to labor effectively in different parts of the world. His life embodied the dedication of early Church members who left their homes to build the kingdom.
church_summary: George Teasdale served as a dedicated missionary in multiple locations, including Mexico, and was ordained as an apostle in the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. He devoted his life to missionary work and ecclesiastical service, demonstrating consistent commitment to advancing the Church's growth. His service spanned the period of significant institutional development and he participated in key Church councils and decisions of his era. He died in 1907 at an advanced age, having spent decades in Church leadership.
